query:
UPDATE repositories
           SET sync_status     = CASE
                                     WHEN last_error IS NOT NULL THEN 'FAILED'
                                     WHEN head_commit_sha IS NULL THEN 'PENDING'
                                     ELSE 'READY'
                                 END,
               sync_started_at = NULL,
               next_sync_at    = $1
           WHERE sync_status = 'SYNCING'
